notes.title: AUTOMATIONS + New ECOSYSTEM!
notes.content:
[h1]A New Way to Play[/h1]

Through community feedback, whether from game reviews or posts, I realized that Work Adventure was too interactive when the main mechanic of a desktop game should be more automated. With that in mind, three 100% AUTOMATED units have been added to the game! One of them appears randomly when you start a session and roams the map, collecting resources and destroying objects!

Thinking about a more Idle/AFK experience, this automated unit shares all the properties of the left mouse click, meaning it consumes energy when attacking, but its attack power/XP gain also increases according to attributes.

Initial energy consumption values have been adjusted to higher levels, aiming for a longer progression time at the start of the game, as there is now an automated unit.

[list]
[*] Energy Cost per Attack [strike]0.5[/strike] -> 2.5
[*] Energy Factor per Attack (Every 5 levels) [strike]0.1[/strike] -> 0.5
[*] The center button now centers on the UNIT instead of the map
[/list]

[h1]Don't Wait to Capture![/h1]

One of the game's features that not everyone liked was the need to wait for a specific time of day to capture all creature types. Considering players who may not have access to certain playtimes, a new button has been added to the game interface that allows disabling the time-based creature spawn. This makes creature spawns random among all existing creatures in Work Adventure.

[h1]Even More Improvements![/h1]

A new screen has been added, indicating the ideal way to position multiple monitors so that the game functions correctly across different resolutions.

Previously, the game ran without vertical sync (VSYNC). Now, it is limited to the user's monitor refresh rate, preventing visual bugs or unnecessary FPS overuse.

notes.title: Saying Goodbye to the Christmas Event | Addition of the CULTISTS + New Creatures
notes.content:
[h1]End of the Christmas Event[/h1]

The Christmas event has unfortunately come to an end! With that, we temporarily say goodbye to the special creatures and the festive Christmas theme!

[h1]A New Group of Creatures! Cultists[/h1]

Have you ever wanted to create or join a cult? Your time has come! A new group of creatures has been added to the game, featuring exclusive units for your collection! They are:

[olist]
[*] Necromancer
[*] Witch
[*] Cultist
[*] Bandit
[*] Spiders
[/olist]

In addition to the cultists, the following creatures have been added and distributed among other groups:

[olist]
[*] Humanoid Ogre
[*] Bats
[*] Alien
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

Some known bugs reported by the community have been fixed in this update! The main one (and probably the most impactful for gameplay) was the bugged rock spawn (One plural word made all the difference in the code!)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.3 (THE FUTURE OF WORK ADVENTURE)
notes.content:
[h2][b]GENERAL[/b][/h2

[list]
[*] The Tutorial no longer opens automatically when starting the game (Instead, a constant animation is displayed on the button, encouraging the user to click it).
[*] Number of consumable items in the market [strike]3 ~ 7[/strike] -> 5.
[*] Copies of consumable items in the market [strike]1 ~ 5[/strike] -> 1.
[*] Price of consumable items in the market [strike]10x[/strike] -> 10 ~ 20x.
[/list]

[h2][b]ATTRIBUTES[/b][/h2

[list]
[*] Energy consumption [strike]0.5[/strike] -> 1.0 ... 1.1 ... 1.2 (Increases every 5 levels).
[*] Starting Energy [strike]20[/strike] -> 50.
[/list]

[h2][b]TASK SYSTEM[/b][/h2

[list]
[*] A TASK SYSTEM has been added to the game!
[*] The game now features random missions that can be obtained upon leveling up. Tasks are divided into groups: [b]Gathering[/b], [b]Destruction[/b], [b]Building[/b], and [b]Taming[/b].
[*] A progression system has been implemented, making tasks harder as you advance, but providing greater rewards.
[/list]

[h2][b]RESOURCES AND RESOURCE POINTS[/b][/h2

[list]
[*] Entities and objects defeated to gain points [strike]10[/strike] -> 15.
[*] Initial number of jars and chests/boxes [strike]15[/strike] -> 1.
[*] Maximum number of jars and chests/boxes [strike]22[/strike] -> 5.
[*] Cost to increase the number of jars and chests/boxes [strike]1[/strike] -> 10.
[*] Cost to increase the maximum number of entities [strike]1[/strike] -> 3.
[*] Luck increase per point invested [strike]0.5%[/strike] -> 1.0%.
[*] Cost to increase luck [strike]1[/strike] -> 5.
[*] Creature spawn time [strike]25 ~ 50s - 7 ~ 14s[/strike] -> 120 ~ 300s - 30 ~ 75s.
[*] Resource spawn time [strike]10 ~ 15s - 1 ~ 2s[/strike] -> 30 ~ 60s -> 4 ~ 8s.
[/list]

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in buildings that generated experience gains for the user.
[*] Fixed a bug where mouse panning didn't work at 3X zoom.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Buildings now provide benefits to the player (Max Energy, Energy per Second, Attack, Experience Gain).
[*] The inventory now opens with a pre-selected filter.
[*] The Music icon has been replaced with a Volume icon.
[*] Tooltips have been added when hovering over the inventory filters.
[*] The Tutorial now opens when starting the game.
[*] A popup appears when starting a new game (Prevents accidental clicks from deleting the old save).
[/list]

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented consumable items from being placed on the ground.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]In this update, several improvements have been made for users! These include:[/h1]  

[h2][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2]  

[list]  
[*] ENERGY COST PER ACTION HAS BEEN REDUCED: 1 -> 0.5  
[*] Right-click now moves the map (Mouse Pan)  
[*] Hovering the mouse over a creature now displays its name! (This can be disabled in settings)  
[*] Taming items left on the ground (with a visible aura) now return to the inventory after right-clicking  
[*] Pressing the "X" on buildings or the inventory returns resources to the inventory and cancels the current action  
[*] Minimum spawn time for resources has been reduced by 0.1 seconds for the minimum and 0.5 seconds for the maximum. With all points invested, the total cooldown is reduced to 1~2 seconds  
[*] Added a LUCK resource, granting a bonus to resource drops from OBJECTS ranging from 0~25% additional chances  
[*] Added 3X Zoom to the game  
[*] Added buttons to mute music and sound effects on the main menu  
[*] Added four filter buttons in the inventory to view items by category  
[*] Added a button to sell all items in the inventory based on the selected category  
[*] Standardized the "X" button to close windows across all game screens  
[/list]  

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]  

[list]  
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented users with multiple monitors from selecting other screens  
[*] Fixed a bug where the game's main menu did not adapt to the correct resolution on 2560x1440 and 3840x2160 monitors  
[/list]
